enabled.title: Enable Artifacts
enabled.description: Enable the GraphJin-managed SQL artifact store for saved queries/fragments/workflows and catalog annotations; parsed dev and agentic configs default to enabled

source.title: Artifact Source
source.description: Database source name that hosts the artifact store; omitted dev and agentic configs use private managed SQLite while legacy explicit enablement uses the first writable SQL source

schema.title: Artifact Schema
schema.description: Schema for the artifact store tables

auto_init.title: Auto Initialize Artifact Tables
auto_init.description: Create artifact store tables automatically at startup

globals_path.title: Global Config Artifact Path
globals_path.description: Directory of read-only global artifacts loaded from config files

locked.title: Locked Artifact Kinds
locked.description: Artifact kinds that refuse writes through gj_artifacts

poll_seconds.title: Artifact Poll Seconds
poll_seconds.description: Fallback and reconnect interval for internal artifact and watch revision subscriptions

projection_content_max_bytes.title: Projection Content Max Bytes
projection_content_max_bytes.description: Per-field byte cap for content and JSON fields in the in-memory gj_artifacts search projection; oversized values are dropped from the projection but stay fully readable through the artifact store

max_per_owner.title: Max Artifacts Per Owner
max_per_owner.description: Shared maximum catalog-visible saved-query fragment and workflow artifacts per owner; existing rows remain updatable at the cap

token_ttl.title: Issued Token TTL
token_ttl.description: TTL of issued local JWTs (default: 720h = 30 days)

issuer.title: JWT Issuer Claim
issuer.description:
Issuer value stamped onto every locally-minted JWT. Must match
`auth.jwt.issuer` if that is set.

audience.title: JWT Audience Claim
audience.description:
Audience value stamped onto every locally-minted JWT. Must match
`auth.jwt.audience` if that is set. Defaults to "graphjin-cli".

audience_graphjin.title: Use GraphJin Default Audience (graphjin-cli)
audience_graphjin.description:
AudienceGraphjin is a convenience shortcut: when true, the issued JWT's
`aud` claim is set to the canonical value "graphjin-cli". Saves having
to remember / type the magic string. Mutually exclusive with Audience.

oidc.title: OIDC Provider
oidc.description: OIDC identity provider used to authenticate humans.

AuthLogin.description: AuthLogin configures the built-in OIDC sign-in flow that issues local JWTs for `graphjin cli` / `graphjin mcp` clients.

issuer_url.title: OIDC Issuer URL
issuer_url.description:
OIDC issuer URL — discovery happens at
<issuer_url>/.well-known/openid-configuration

client_id.title: OAuth Client ID
client_id.description: Registered OAuth client ID / secret for this GraphJin deployment.

allowed_emails.title: Allowed Email Addresses
allowed_emails.description:
Optional post-authentication allow-lists. If both are empty, any verified
identity is accepted.

AuthLoginOIDC.description: AuthLoginOIDC configures a generic OIDC identity provider for AuthLogin.

disable.title: Disable Caching
disable.description: Disable response caching (caching is enabled by default)

ttl.title: Cache TTL
ttl.description: Default TTL for cached responses in seconds (hard TTL)

fresh_ttl.title: Fresh TTL for SWR
fresh_ttl.description: Soft TTL for stale-while-revalidate in seconds (0 = disabled)

CachingConfig.description: CachingConfig configures response caching Caching is enabled by default using in-memory LRU cache Configure redis.url to use Redis for distributed caching Responses are cached with automatic invalidation when mutations modify related tables

max_connections.title: Maximum Connections
max_connections.description: Max number of active database connections allowed

max_connection_idle_time.title: Connection Idel Time
max_connection_idle_time.description: Max time after which idle database connections are closed

max_connection_life_time.title: Connection Life Time
max_connection_life_time.description: Max time after which database connections are not reused

ping_timeout.title: Healthcheck Ping Timeout
ping_timeout.description: Database ping timeout is used for db health checking

enable_tls.title: Enable TLS
enable_tls.description: Set up an secure TLS encrypted database connection

server_name.title: TLS Server Name
server_name.description:
Required for TLS. For example with Google Cloud SQL it's
<gcp-project-id>:<cloud-sql-instance>

server_cert.title: Server Certificate
server_cert.description: Required for TLS. Can be a file path or the contents of the PEM file

client_cert.title: Client Certificate
client_cert.description: Required for TLS. Can be a file path or the contents of the PEM file

client_key.title: Client Key
client_key.description: Required for TLS. Can be a file path or the contents of the pem file

encrypt.title: MSSQL Encrypt
encrypt.description: MSSQL: disable TLS encryption (default: true in go-mssqldb)

trust_server_certificate.title: MSSQL Trust Server Certificate
trust_server_certificate.description: MSSQL: trust server certificate without validation

private_key_path.title: Private Key File Path (Snowflake)
private_key_path.description:
Snowflake key pair authentication (PKCS#8 PEM format).
Generate key: openssl genrsa 2048 | openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -inform PEM -out rsa_key.p8

consistency.title: Cassandra Consistency Level
consistency.description: Cassandra / Amazon Keyspaces consistency level (default LOCAL_QUORUM).

enabled.title: Enable Discovery Cache
enabled.description:
Enabled starts GraphJin Service from validated filesystem generations and
moves schema refreshes onto the coordinated generation path.

path.title: Discovery Cache Path
path.description:
Path stores immutable full schema snapshots, manifests, activation
receipts, and semantic indexes. Horizontal replicas must share this path.

refresh_interval.title: Discovery Refresh Interval
refresh_interval.description: RefreshInterval controls background live-schema checks after startup.

startup_wait.title: Discovery Startup Wait
startup_wait.description: StartupWait bounds cold follower and explicit refresh activation waits.

retain_generations.title: Retained Discovery Generations
retain_generations.description:
RetainGenerations is the number of activated generations kept when the
configured filesystem supports deletion.

DiscoveryCacheConfig.description: DiscoveryCacheConfig configures service-owned schema discovery generations.

KeystoreConfig.description: KeystoreConfig configures the local encrypted keystore.

disable.title: Disable MCP Server
disable.description:
Disable the MCP server. MCP is enabled by default except for legacy
database-only prod/agentic configs, where it must be explicitly enabled.

oauth.title: MCP OAuth Configuration
oauth.description: OAuth exposes standards-compatible authorization discovery for remote MCP clients.

allow_mutations.title: Allow Mutations
allow_mutations.description:
Allow mutation operations via raw MCP GraphQL execution.
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

allow_raw_queries.title: Allow Raw Queries
allow_raw_queries.description:
Allow arbitrary GraphQL queries (vs only saved queries from allow-list)
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

include_tools_with_agent.title: Include MCP Tools With Agent
include_tools_with_agent.description: Parsed dev and agentic configs default to true; prod and direct Go configs remain false

http_stateful.title: Stateful MCP HTTP Transport
http_stateful.description: Parsed dev and agentic configs default to true; prod and direct Go configs remain false

legacy_discovery.title: Enable Legacy Discovery Tools
legacy_discovery.description:
LegacyDiscovery keeps legacy HTTP helper endpoints such as
/api/v1/discovery and /api/v1/workflows available for compatibility.
It no longer expands the MCP tool surface; MCP is catalog-first.

stdio_user_id.title: Stdio User ID
stdio_user_id.description: Default user ID for stdio transport (CLI). Can be overridden by GRAPHJIN_USER_ID env var.

stdio_user_role.title: Stdio User Role
stdio_user_role.description: Default user role for stdio transport (CLI). Can be overridden by GRAPHJIN_USER_ROLE env var.

only.title: MCP Only Mode
only.description:
Run in MCP-only mode - disables GraphQL, REST saved-query API, WebUI, and OpenAPI endpoints.
Health check and MCP endpoints remain available. Legacy HTTP helper endpoints
also remain available only when legacy_discovery is enabled.

cursor_cache_ttl.title: Cursor Cache TTL
cursor_cache_ttl.description:
CursorCacheTTL in seconds for cursor ID cache (default: 1800 = 30 min)
Cursors are cached to allow short numeric IDs for LLM-friendly pagination

cursor_cache_size.title: Cursor Cache Size
cursor_cache_size.description: CursorCacheSize max entries for in-memory cursor cache fallback (default: 10000)

allow_config_updates.title: Allow Config Updates
allow_config_updates.description:
AllowConfigUpdates enables MCP tools that can modify GraphJin configuration
WARNING: Allows LLMs to change database connections, table configs, and roles
Only enable in trusted environments. Default: false

allow_schema_reload.title: Allow Schema Reload
allow_schema_reload.description:
AllowSchemaReload enables the MCP reload_schema tool for manual schema refresh
Useful when user adds tables and wants immediate discovery without waiting for poll
Default: false (auto-enabled in dev mode if not explicitly set)

allow_schema_updates.title: Allow Schema Updates
allow_schema_updates.description:
AllowSchemaUpdates enables MCP tools to preview and apply database schema changes (DDL)
Uses GraphJin DDL (db.ddl) format. Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

allow_workflow_updates.title: Allow Workflow Updates
allow_workflow_updates.description:
AllowWorkflowUpdates enables workflow writes through gj_workflow.
Saved workflows are discoverable via workflow catalog items. Execution
through gj_workflow_execution is controlled by normal read_only table/source
configuration because it is an insert-shaped managed mutation.
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

allow_workflow_execution.title: Allow Workflow Execution
allow_workflow_execution.description:
AllowWorkflowExecution keeps the legacy HTTP workflow execution surface
available when legacy discovery is enabled. MCP workflow execution uses
catalog discovery plus gj_workflow_execution.
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

allow_dev_tools.title: Allow Dev Tools
allow_dev_tools.description:
AllowDevTools enables advanced introspection MCP tools (explain_query, explore_relationships, audit_role_permissions).
These expose SQL, relationship graphs, and role permissions — useful for development/debugging.
Auto-enabled in dev mode. Default: false

default_db_allowed.title: Allow Default Databases
default_db_allowed.description:
DefaultDBAllowed when true allows configuring and discovering system/default
databases (e.g. postgres, mysql, master). Default: false

workflow_timeout.title: Workflow Timeout (seconds)
workflow_timeout.description:
WorkflowTimeout in seconds for JavaScript workflow execution.
Workflows that exceed this duration are interrupted. Default: 5

MCPConfig.description: MCPConfig configures the Model Context Protocol (MCP) server MCP enables AI assistants to interact with GraphJin via function calling

enabled.title: Enable MCP OAuth
enabled.description: Enable OAuth metadata/challenge support for the MCP HTTP endpoint.

mode.title: MCP OAuth Mode
mode.description:
Mode selects the authorization-server strategy: builtin uses auth_login
to run an authorization-code + PKCE flow; external advertises the
configured AuthorizationServers and validates bearer tokens via auth.jwt.

resource.title: MCP OAuth Resource
resource.description:
Resource is the expected OAuth audience/resource value. Defaults to the
public /api/v1/mcp URL for the incoming request.

issuer.title: MCP OAuth Issuer
issuer.description:
Issuer is the authorization server issuer. In builtin mode it defaults to
the public origin of the incoming request.

authorization_servers.title: MCP OAuth Authorization Servers
authorization_servers.description:
AuthorizationServers are advertised by protected-resource metadata in
external mode. Defaults to Issuer when empty.

scopes.title: MCP OAuth Scopes
scopes.description: Scopes advertised and accepted by the MCP authorization server.

dynamic_client_registration.title: Enable MCP OAuth Dynamic Client Registration
dynamic_client_registration.description: DynamicClientRegistration exposes RFC 7591 registration in builtin mode.

client_id_metadata_documents.title: Enable MCP OAuth Client ID Metadata Documents
client_id_metadata_documents.description: ClientIDMetadataDocuments lets clients use CIMD URLs instead of DCR.

access_token_ttl.title: MCP OAuth Access Token TTL
access_token_ttl.description: AccessTokenTTL controls builtin-mode access token lifetime.

refresh_token_ttl.title: MCP OAuth Refresh Token TTL
refresh_token_ttl.description: RefreshTokenTTL controls builtin-mode refresh token lifetime.

MCPOAuthConfig.description: MCPOAuthConfig configures standards-compatible OAuth discovery and token handling for hosted MCP HTTP clients.

rate.title: Connection Rate
rate.description: The number of events per second

bucket.title: Bucket Size
bucket.description: Bucket a burst of at most 'bucket' number of events

ip_header.title: IP From HTTP Header
ip_header.description: The header that contains the client ip

RateLimiter.description: RateLimiter sets the API rate limits

max_events.title: Runtime Event Limit
max_events.description: MaxEvents is the maximum number of recent event rows retained.

ttl_seconds.title: Runtime Event TTL Seconds
ttl_seconds.description: TTLSeconds controls how long event rows are retained.

RuntimeEventsConfig.description: RuntimeEventsConfig configures bounded agentic runtime observability rows.

SecretsConfig.description: SecretsConfig configures secret storage for write-only config inputs.

enabled.title: Enable Semantic Catalog Search
enabled.description: Enabled adds Ax-backed semantic recall to the lexical catalog baseline.

provider.title: Embedding Provider
provider.description: Provider is the Ax embedding provider name.

embedding_model.title: Embedding Model
embedding_model.description:
EmbeddingModel is required when semantic search is enabled and forms part
of the persisted embedding-space fingerprint.

api_key_env.title: Embedding API Key Environment Variable
api_key_env.description: APIKeyEnv names the environment variable containing the provider key.

base_url.title: Embedding Provider Base URL
base_url.description:
BaseURL optionally overrides the provider endpoint and forms part of the
persisted embedding-space fingerprint.

dimensions.title: Embedding Dimensions
dimensions.description:
Dimensions selects tiny (128), small (256), medium (512), or the
provider-native default. Named sizes are validated strictly.

SemanticCatalogSearchConfig.description: SemanticCatalogSearchConfig configures the service-owned Ax embedding layer.

enabled.title: Enable Tasks
enabled.description: Enable durable owner-scoped declared-intent tasks; parsed dev and agentic configs default to enabled when artifacts are enabled

max_entries_per_task.title: Max Entries Per Task
max_entries_per_task.description: Maximum stored trail entries per task; oldest are pruned first

entry_retention_hours.title: Task Entry Retention Hours
entry_retention_hours.description: Hours to keep task trail entries before prune-on-write and projection trimming

snapshot_max_bytes.title: Task Snapshot Max Bytes
snapshot_max_bytes.description: Byte cap for task snapshot_json and task-entry detail_json

max_size.title: Max Upload Size (bytes)
max_size.description:
MaxSize is the per-request multipart body limit in bytes.
Defaults to 25 MB when zero.

allowed_mime.title: Allowed MIME Types
allowed_mime.description:
AllowedMIME, when non-empty, restricts the accepted content types.
Glob patterns are supported: "image/*", "application/pdf".

storage.title: Filesystem Table for Streaming
storage.description:
Storage names a filesystems[].name to stream uploads into. When
empty, the legacy inline-base64 mode is used. When set, files
are written to the backend and the variable becomes the object
metadata instead of inlined data.

storage_key_prefix.title: Storage Key Prefix
storage_key_prefix.description:
StorageKeyPrefix is prepended to the backend key for every
uploaded file. Useful for namespacing by tenant or role.
Example: "avatars/{date}/" — the {date} marker is substituted
at request time with YYYY/MM/DD.

UploadsConfig.description: UploadsConfig configures the multipart-form upload endpoint following the graphql-multipart-request-spec (https://github.com/jaydenseric/graphql-multipart-request-spec).

enabled.title: Enable Watches
enabled.description: Enable durable owner-scoped watches; parsed dev and agentic configs default to enabled when artifacts are enabled

event_retention_hours.title: Watch Event Retention Hours
event_retention_hours.description: Hours to keep fired watch events before pruning

max_events_per_watch.title: Max Events Per Watch
max_events_per_watch.description: Maximum stored events per watch; oldest are pruned first

snapshot_max_bytes.title: Watch Snapshot Max Bytes
snapshot_max_bytes.description: Byte cap for stored event snapshots and user-supplied watch-definition JSON fields

runner.title: Watch Runner
runner.description: Which replicas evaluate watches; parsed dev and agentic configs default to all while literal and prod configs remain off

webhook_allow.title: Watch Webhook Allowlist
webhook_allow.description: Allowlist of webhook URL prefixes watch deliveries may call; empty denies all webhooks

enrichment_daily_cap.title: Watch Enrichment Daily Cap
enrichment_daily_cap.description: Maximum read-only agent enrichments per watch per day

retry_max_failures.title: Watch Retry Max Failures
retry_max_failures.description: Consecutive transient runner failures before a watch enters terminal error status

subs_target_query_latency.title: Subscription Target Query Latency
subs_target_query_latency.description: When zero this is auto-derived as 25% of subs_poll_duration

analytics_mode.title: Analytics Mode
analytics_mode.description: Disable implicit row-limit defaults for OLAP deployments

production.title: Production Mode
production.description: Legacy production switch. Prefer top-level mode for new configs.

app_name.title: Application Name
app_name.description: Application name is used in log and debug messages

config_path.title: Config Path
config_path.description: The default path to find all configuration files and scripts

log_level.title: Log Level
log_level.description: Logging level must be one of debug, error, warn, info

log_format.title: Logging Format
log_format.description:
Logging Format: "auto" (default, colored console in dev, JSON in production),
"json" (always JSON), or "simple" (always colored console)

host_port.title: Host and Port
host_port.description: The host and port the service runs on. Example localhost:8080

host.title: Host
host.description: Host to run the service on

port.title: Port
port.description: Port to run the service on

web_ui.title: Enable Web UI
web_ui.description: Enable the web UI. Defaults on in dev and agentic modes, off in prod.

reload_on_config_change.title: Reload Config
reload_on_config_change.description: Enables reloading the service on config changes. Disabled in production

auth_fail_block.title: Block Request on Authorization Failure
auth_fail_block.description: Enable blocking requests with a HTTP 401 on auth failure

cors_allowed_origins.title: HTTP CORS Allowed Origins
cors_allowed_origins.description: Sets the HTTP CORS Access-Control-Allow-Origin header

cors_allowed_headers.title: HTTP CORS Allowed Headers
cors_allowed_headers.description: Sets the HTTP CORS Access-Control-Allow-Headers header

auth.title: Authentication
auth.description: Sets the default authentication used by the service

auth_login.title: Built-in Login (OIDC)
auth_login.description: Built-in OIDC login that mints local JWTs for the CLI / MCP client

inherits.title: Inherit From Config File
inherits.description:
Name of another config file in the same directory to inherit and
override (one level only; the inherited file cannot itself inherit).
Example: prod.yml sets `inherits: dev` to start from dev.yml values.

title: GraphJin Configuration
description: Configuration for the GraphJin service and compiler core (dev.yml / prod.yml / agentic.yml).
